title: What are some FreshBooks alternatives?
text: Hi there, InvoiceBerry is an alternative to Freshbooks. You can create, send and manage your invoices online and keep track of payments and expenses. It’s used by tens of thousands of small businesses and freelancers from around the world. title: My freelance client is not paying me on time, is this a sign I should drop them as a client?
text: Rediscuss your contract. Next assignements come with a 50% advance, otherwise they won't get a byte. No further assignements as long as there are unpaid invoices. If they like you they'll make a hell at first but then they'll accept. Take that contract and frame it, when they're again in delay reply with the contract pdf.
